description: Fork of exp475 (bs=16, 1.4962). SINGLE change: inverse-frequency token loss weighting during TRAINING (eval bpb stays standard/unweighted). w(t)=(smoothed_freq)^-alpha, alpha=0.5, capped at 5x, normalized so freq-weighted mean weight=1. Tests the exp486 analysis finding that bs=48's gain is concentrated on RARE tokens: upweighting rare-token loss feeds their LUT paths more gradient per step, aiming to recover part of the bs=48 gain at bs=16 (1x tokens). token_freq.pt precomputed from 16.4M train tokens. Everything else identical to exp475.
